name: Nishina Yuka
source:
A highly capable woman who heads the management division at the talent agency Star Princess.
Her gentle demeanor belies an uncompromising work style; she is a formidable professional who handles everything from producing talent to overseas business development.
She was apparently a hardcore idol fan in her student days, though there is little trace of that side of her now. These days, she in a workaholic through and through.

[From in-game tips]
